limitations: Review is for these exact working-tree hashes, not a future commit or independently fetched PR head. Parent changed ledger during the review; final applied-ledger inspection is pinned to 0b73a73d5d86fc0190b57f89bff4c50eb060de70493c1d480faddcf19d44a5ae.
This review does not certify all scientific claims, taxonomy decisions, source licensing, detection arguments or example eligibility. Earlier grounding dossiers remain separate evidence.

Exact-byte editor idempotency is verified. Native merge_on_reseed preserves semantics but reformats 13 outputs; applying the editor after such formatting correctly requires re-review because exact output pins no longer match. No seeder byte-idempotency claim is made.

Apply is atomic per record, not a whole-batch filesystem transaction. A later I/O failure or concurrent change can leave earlier valid writes applied; exact input/output hashes support conservative recovery.

The existing canonical_examples preservation adversarial probe uses an empty block; actual 24 targets have zero examples. Protection of nonempty examples follows the allowlist and exact unchanged-key transform, not a newly qualified example integration test.
writes_by_reviewer: Own grounding research JSON artifacts, pytest cache and temporary fixture/preview files only. No code, scientific record, seeder, registry, branch, session or other checkout modifications.
